teamLeadership.label: Team Leadership
teamLeadership.description: Lead team meetings and manage conflicts

steps.question: What is your immediate course of action?

options.A: Ignore the issue and hope the team can catch up.
options.B: Inform the stakeholders about the delay.
options.C: Reassign the work to a different team.
options.D: Pressure the team to work overtime.

steps.question: How do you handle the team's response to your decision?

options.A: Schedule a team meeting to discuss the situation openly.
options.B: Send an email update and wait for responses.
options.D: Let the team figure it out on their own.

steps.question: What's your approach to stakeholder communication?

options.B: Set up a crisis management meeting.
options.C: Create a revised project timeline with milestones.

steps.question: How do you ensure project recovery and future prevention?

options.B: Conduct a post-mortem analysis with the team.
options.C: Hire additional resources for the project.
options.D: Move on and focus on the next project.
